blog.nam2: Ho Chi Minh City is the most bustling and crowded city in the South and across the country. Located in the Southeast region, it preserves many unique architectural works, entertainment areas, and busy shopping centers. Therefore, Ho Chi Minh City is always a top choice for visitors. The ideal time to visit is during the dry season from December to April. Popular attractions include Notre-Dame Cathedral, Independence Palace, and the Opera House.
blog.nam4: Long An is only 35km from Saigon and features the typical river culture of the Mekong Delta. It has cajeput forests, modern attractions like the Seven Wonders Park, revolutionary relics, Tan Lap floating village, the Hundred-Column House, Rio Water Park, and Phuoc Loc Tho Ancient Village.
blog.nam6: Blessed with a warm climate all year round, Tien Giang is not only famous for being a major rice bowl but also for its attractive tourist destinations such as Vinh Trang Pagoda, Thoi Son Islet, Cai Be Floating Market, Dong Tam Snake Farm, Linh Thu Pagoda, and Truc Lam Chanh Giac Zen Monastery, reflecting the rich culture of the Mekong Delta.
blog.nam8: Dong Thap is famous for vast lotus fields and the peaceful rural landscape. It is also known for Sa Dec Flower Village, Xeo Quyt Tourist Area, Tram Chim National Park, Huynh Thuy Le Ancient House, Lotus Leaf Pagoda, Gao Giong Ecotourism Area, and the Tomb of Nguyen Sinh Sac with historical relics and unspoiled natural beauty.
blog.nam10: Ben Tre not only captivates with its peaceful river scenery but also offers unique culture and cuisine. Visitors can enjoy the tranquility of the coconut-shaded rivers with highlights like Phung Islet, Quy Islet, Lan Vuong Tourist Area, Minh Islet, Lang Be Tourist Area, and the Coconut Religion relics.
blog.nam11: A vibrant, hospitable land rich in identity

blog.bac2: The best time to visit Hanoi is in the autumn from August to November and in the spring from March to April. Many people believe that autumn is the most beautiful season in Hanoi, with clear blue skies, cool breezes, falling yellow leaves, and the faint scent of milk flowers... In spring, the weather warms up, and the streets transform as trees sprout and flowers bloom everywhere.
blog.bac4: Yen Bai province is located in the Northwest, about 160 km from Hanoi, bordering Tuyen Quang, Phu Tho, Lai Chau, Son La, Lao Cai, and Ha Giang. It consists of Yen Bai city, Nghia Lo town, and 7 districts: Yen Binh, Luc Yen, Van Chan, Van Yen, Tran Yen, Tram Tau, and Mu Cang Chai. Yen Bai is famous for its terraced fields, golden season, and water pouring season. It also boasts majestic peaks, hot springs, ancient villages, and unique cuisine.
blog.bac6: Sapa — a name that symbolizes the beauty of the Northwestern mountains — is a destination that touches every heart. From the majestic Fansipan peak reaching into the clouds to the peaceful villages nestled in valleys, every corner of Sapa tells a story and possesses a unique charm that captivates visitors.
blog.bac7: Top Must-Visit Destinations in Northern Vietnam
blog.bac8: Northern Vietnam is famous for its stunning natural landscapes, rich culture, and distinctive cuisine
blog.trung2: Quang Binh province is located in the North Central Coast region. It borders Ha Tinh to the north, Quang Tri to the south, Laos to the west, and the East Sea to the east. Its capital is Dong Hoi city. The climate in Quang Binh has two distinct seasons: the rainy season from September to March and the dry season from April to August. From November to around March, temperatures can drop to around 17–22°C. The best time to visit is from late March to early September.
blog.trung4: Hue is famous for the Imperial Citadel, Thien Mu Pagoda, and its poetic, ancient beauty. The tourism season in Hue runs from November to April, with the best months being January to April thanks to the mild weather. For travelers who love the sea, mountains, sunrise, and sunset, June to August is ideal when the sun is most beautiful and the sea is at its clearest. Spring lasts from late January to March, featuring light sunshine and cool breezes. Summer from April to July is hot but perfect for beach lovers. In summer, Hue is adorned with golden flamboyant flowers, pink cassia blossoms, and purple crape myrtles. In August, autumn arrives, the most beautiful season in Hue.
blog.trung6: Da Nang – Vietnam’s most livable city, is famous for the Dragon Bridge, My Khe Beach, and amazing cuisine. The climate is a transition between the North and South with a dominant tropical southern pattern. There are two distinct seasons: dry from January to July and rainy from August to December. Occasional cold spells occur in winter but are short and not severe.

news.ti2: Pacific Travel Corporation has officially launched a new tour featuring direct charter flights from Hanoi to the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China. Inner Mongolia, covering an area of 1.2 million km² and bordering Russia and Mongolia, is a region rich in cultural fusion. Tourists can experience sleeping in a yurt in the grasslands, admire ancient Russian architecture, savor Chinese-Mongolian cuisine, and participate in unique cultural festivals. The Inner Mongolian government continuously introduces tourism-promoting policies, attracting hundreds of millions of visitors annually.
news.ti4: The tour takes place in the summer (July - August), the ideal time to explore Inner Mongolia. This period coincides with the Naadam Festival, featuring traditional horseback riding, archery, and wrestling competitions. The itinerary includes unique experiences such as horseback riding across the steppes, exploring the Resonant Sand Desert, checking in at the Zhenbei Western Film Studio, and witnessing stunning grassland sunsets. Direct charter flights to Inner Mongolia not only promote bilateral tourism but also create business cooperation opportunities between the two countries.
news.ti6: The mysterious land of Inner Mongolia entices travelers with its vast and majestic landscapes, combining deserts, grasslands, diverse cultural experiences, and warm, hospitable locals.
news.ti7: Camel riding in the Resonant Sand Desert of Inner Mongolia is an exciting experience for adventure and exploration enthusiasts.
